name: Volumetric Light Shafts (Cone Raymarching)
definition: A post-processing technique that renders volumetric light shafts by raymarching through a cone-shaped volume originating from a light source, using Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) to define the volume shape and noise for density variation.
summary: Volumetric Light Shafts (Cone Raymarching) is a screen-space post-processing technique that renders directional light shafts tapering from a light source using cone SDFs, differing from standard methods by avoiding box or sphere primitives.
